name: @agntux/orchestrator-mcp-server
description: Local stdio MCP server for the agntux-core orchestrator plugin. Also exposes the AgntUX project-root resolver as a sibling-plugin library subpath so other AgntUX plugins (e.g. agntux-slack) can reuse the same resolver instead of vendor-copying.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --target=node18 --sourcemap --allow-overwrite --banner:js='import { createRequire as _esmCreateRequire } from "module"; const require = _esmCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' && node scripts/embed-bundle.mjs
